title: Important: gdm security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description:
The GNOME Display Manager (GDM) provides the graphical login screen. The screen is shown shortly after boot, after log out, and when switching the current user.

Security Fix(es):

* gdm: Missing authorization on CreateRemoteDisplay allows autologin as arbitrary users, including root (CVE-2026-132858)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Make smartcard method default when smartcad is inserted in login screen  (gdm) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-287797)

* Unable to switch users with smartcards with virtual terminals disabled (Rocky Linux-10) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-307213)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
